title: React Fundamentals
subtitle: Build modern user interfaces with React from components to routing
description: A comprehensive, project-driven course covering React from first principles through advanced topics. You will master JSX, functional components, props, state, events, forms, the useEffect lifecycle, custom hooks, Context, refs, React Router, multiple styling strategies, and performance optimization. Each module includes hands-on exercises, comparison cards, Mermaid diagrams, and real-world patterns so you can build production-ready React applications with confidence.
